dedupe_keys.name: 赤ちゃんの駅 登録施設一覧 railways and stations

description: 赤ちゃんの駅 登録施設一覧 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 大津市. 赤ちゃんの駅として登録されている施設の一覧です（令和3年3月1日時点） 赤ちゃんの駅は、乳幼児を連れた保護者がオムツ替えや授乳に気軽に立ち寄れる施設です。 子育て家庭の外出を支援し、社会全体で子育てを応援する意識を育むための事業の一つです。 赤ちゃんの駅でできること ・オムツ交換ができる場所の提供 ・授乳ができる場所の提供 ・その他、ミル... Coverage: 大津市. The portal files it under the publisher 大津市. Its tags are 乳幼児, 子育て, 育児, 赤ちゃん. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, xlsx. The portal shows 2025-03-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
